snippet.title: MotoTrials – ENTER THE DEATHGAME | Trailer (PS5/XBOX/STEAM/EPIC)  World Launch 10.10.2025 @ 10:00 AM
snippet.description:
Disoriented, you wake up locked in a shipping container. 

MotoTrials is a 100% physics-based motorcycle death game. You play as Ricky, a lone contestant forced to survive a deadly industrial district, designed to break the human spirit… or prove it’s still alive. 

Blending the nerve-wracking tension of Inside, the sadistic spectacle of Squid Game, and the mechanical madness of Trials, MotoTrials feels like it was carved into concrete with a spark plug.

🏍️ MotoTrials launches worldwide this November on PS5, Xbox, and Steam.
